site.name: American Flag Mine
overview: American Flag Mine is a documented historic gold mine in the Turret Mining District of Chaffee County, with the locality preserved in mineral records and U.S. topographic mapping.

timeline.text: Colorado Bureau of Mines annual reports from these years are cited among the historical references for the American Flag Mine locality.
Mineral-locality and topographic records continue to preserve American Flag Mine as a named Turret-district mine.

moreHistory: Mineral locality records identify gold as the major commodity and list Anaconda Mine, Ethel Consolidation Mine, Crete Mine, and Holdredge Mine among associated historical names for the American Flag locality.
The documented mine locality is approximately 38.63222, -106.00195 in the Turret Mining District.
